b) Reference: the broccoli/cauliflower florets are about 4 cm across. The plate spans roughly 8-9 florets' widths across the middle, giving about 32-36 cm, which overshoots the range. Hidden food: no base layer visible beneath the florets; plate is largely uncovered, so no extra items.
